projects.title: Claims & Label Linter (US + EU)
projects.description: Backend-first compliance engine for dietary supplement labels and e-commerce listings. Scrapes official regulatory sources, stores versioned snapshots/diffs, materializes EU authorized claims into queryable tables, and exposes APIs for jobs + claim search.
highlights: Scrapes official sources and tracks versioned snapshots + diffs
Materializes EU authorized claims into queryable tables
APIs to run jobs and search claims quickly
Designed for production-style data + backend workflows

projects.title: Lingua Sync — Multilingual Voice Pipeline
projects.description: Modular, containerized pipeline that converts video URLs into multilingual narrated audio. Includes audio download, STT, optional translation, and TTS voice synthesis behind a simple REST API.
highlights: End-to-end pipeline: download → STT → translate → TTS
GPU-accelerated transcription using faster-whisper
Voice cloning + style control via OpenVoice
Single endpoint to run the full pipeline

projects.title: Decentralized Voting System (Ethereum DApp)
projects.description: A secure, transparent voting platform built on Ethereum. Users can create elections, add candidates (with IPFS uploads), cast votes via MetaMask, and view real-time results powered by smart contracts.
highlights: Smart-contract driven elections and vote casting
Candidate image uploads via IPFS (Pinata)
Role-based flows and real-time results
Full DApp structure with frontend + contract folders

projects.title: Ludo & Checkers — Web Game Frontend
projects.description: Frontend codebase for browser-based board games (Ludo + Checkers). Built with Angular/TypeScript UI flows and game screens designed for multiplayer gameplay.
highlights: Game UI screens and player flows for web gameplay
TypeScript-based frontend architecture
Designed to pair with Colyseus multiplayer backends
Good base to deploy as a static site

projects.title: Colyseus Multiplayer Backend — Ludo
projects.description: Real-time multiplayer backend for Ludo using Colyseus/WebSockets for room/session orchestration and server-authoritative game state synchronization.
highlights: Room/session based multiplayer architecture
Server-authoritative state sync for fair gameplay
Low-latency WebSocket transport via Colyseus
Extensible structure for tournaments/AI modes

projects.title: Colyseus Multiplayer Backend — Checkers
projects.description: Real-time multiplayer backend for Checkers built with Colyseus and WebSockets for synchronized gameplay, room handling, and game state updates.
highlights: Multiplayer rooms and matchmaking-ready structure
Synchronized server-side game loop patterns
WebSocket-based gameplay updates
Clean separation for game state and transport

projects.title: Admin Panel — React + Redux + Firebase
projects.description: Admin panel web app built using React, Redux, and Firebase. Good foundation for dashboards, content management, and operational tooling.
highlights: Admin panel foundation with modern React patterns
Redux-based state management
Firebase integration-ready for auth/data
Easy to extend with analytics dashboards

projects.title: AWS CDK Pipelines Toolkit
projects.description: TypeScript project scaffold that uses AWS CDK to manage AWS infrastructure and pipelines. Useful as an IaC + CI/CD baseline for cloud projects.
highlights: AWS CDK setup for infrastructure + pipelines
TypeScript-based IaC workflow
Good starter for production-grade deployment patterns
Repo includes practical references/links

projects.title: ADI Uploader Service (.NET Console App)
projects.description: C#/.NET console application/service-style project for handling file-based workflows (uploader service structure). Strong example of Windows automation-oriented engineering.
highlights: Service-style console app structure
Organized project layout with solution + configs
Good base for ingestion/upload automations
Demonstrates practical C# tooling patterns

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.description: A modern, responsive portfolio built with React + Vite + Tailwind and Framer Motion. Fully data-driven via JSON for quick updates (skills, experience, projects) with a filterable projects grid and resume download support.
highlights: Data-driven content using JSON (profile, skills, experience, projects)
Filterable project grid (Frontend/Backend/Cloud/DevOps)
Responsive, accessible UI with subtle animations
Resume download served from /public/resume.pdf
